title: Add Mermaid Diagram Generation to Compose Repo CLI
description: Implement mermaid command with loc-by-projects-bundles-folders-files, loc-by-contributors, and loc-by-language subcommands that generate treemap-beta mermaid diagrams
summary: Added mermaid command to CLI with three subcommands: loc-by-projects-bundles-folders-files, loc-by-contributors, and loc-by-language. Each generates treemap-beta mermaid diagram strings for LOC visualization. All 6 tests pass.
